name: libre-webui
description: Privacy-first AI chat interface. Self-hosted, open source, extensible.

scripts.dev:host: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "cd frontend && npm run dev -- --host --port 8080"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test:package: node --test scripts/test-deprecated-dependencies.mjs && node --test scripts/test-helm-versioning.mjs && node --test scripts/test-tts-example-security.mjs && npm run test:unit --workspace=frontend && npm run build && node --test scripts/test-ollama-library.mjs && node --test scripts/test-chat-context.mjs && node --test scripts/test-chat-rest-responses.mjs && node --test scripts/test-plugin-endpoint-routing.mjs && node --test scripts/test-plugin-capability-routing.mjs && node --test scripts/test-chat-provider-selection.mjs && node --test scripts/test-provider-api-modes.mjs && node --test scripts/test-plugin-variable-overrides.mjs && node --test scripts/test-tts-routing.mjs && node --test scripts/test-image-generation-routing.mjs && node --test scripts/test-work-runtime.mjs && node --test scripts/test-work-provider.mjs && node --test scripts/test-work-agent-guidance.mjs && node --test scripts/test-work-agent-loop.mjs && node --test scripts/test-work-events.mjs && node --test scripts/test-package-layout.mjs && node --test scripts/test-release-notes.mjs && node --test scripts/test-release-status.mjs && node --test scripts/test-docker-layout.mjs && node --test scripts/test-electron-macos-signing.mjs && node --test scripts/test-pr-quality-gates.mjs && node --test scripts/test-homebrew-publishing.mjs && node --test scripts/test-forgejo-release-mirror.mjs
scripts.test:work: npm run build:backend && node --test scripts/test-work-runtime.mjs && node --test scripts/test-work-provider.mjs && node --test scripts/test-work-agent-guidance.mjs && node --test scripts/test-work-agent-loop.mjs && node --test scripts/test-work-events.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run security:audit && npm run test:package && npm run npm:publish:dry-run
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:frontend && npm run lint:fix:backend
scripts.setup-hooks: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && git config commit.template .gitmessage
scripts.electron:build: ELECTRON_BUILD=true npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder build --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder build --win --publish never
scripts.electron:build:linux: ELECTRON_BUILD=true npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder build --linux --publish never

author: Libre WebUI Contributors <contact@librewebui.org>
